name: io.github.JKHeadley/moltbridge
description: Agent network intelligence for AI agents. Trust scoring, broker discovery, and Ed25519 identity.

tools.name: moltbridge_register_agent
tools.description: Register a new agent on the MoltBridge network with Ed25519 cryptographic identity

tools.name: moltbridge_discover_broker
tools.description: Find trust paths between agents using graph-based broker discovery

tools.name: moltbridge_get_trust_score
tools.description: Get the trust score between two agents based on attestations and graph distance

tools.name: moltbridge_attest_trust
tools.description: Create a signed trust attestation for another agent

tools.name: moltbridge_search_agents
tools.description: Search for agents by capability, name, or trust criteria

tools.name: moltbridge_get_agent_card
tools.description: Retrieve an agent's public identity card with capabilities and trust metrics
